audience: accountants and finance teams who file CT600 returns and Companies House accounts

useCases.title: Check accounting periods and due dates
useCases.text: List your companies. Then read the accounting periods and due dates of one company, with its filed flags.

useCases.title: Add a company and open a draft filing
useCases.text: Add a UK company by its Companies House number. Then create a draft CT600 filing for one accounting period.

useCases.title: Save the figures of a draft filing
useCases.text: Save the profit and loss and balance sheet figures of a draft. WeFile computes the totals and the tax.

useCases.title: Generate the filing documents
useCases.text: List the documents a filing can produce. Generate the accounts, the tax computation or the CT600 as PDF or iXBRL.

useCases.title: Submit a filing and check the result
useCases.text: Send a filing to HMRC or Companies House, then check its status and submission history. Try a test key first.
